subject: Marketplace procurement sprint: vendor paperwork & PO path (Orion Systems)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.example>
To: Procurement Ops <procurement@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace procurement sprint: vendor paperwork & PO path (Orion Systems)

Hi Jordan / Procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier today — pleased to kick off onboarding for Orion Systems onto the Redwood marketplace. To keep the sprint tight, here are the items we need to collect in the next two weeks so we can issue a PO and start listing: 

Required items (deliverable list):
- Completed supplier intake form (attached stub)
- W-9 (or equivalent tax form for non-US entities)
- Legal company registration (PDF) and primary billing entity name
- Bank wiring details / remit-to contact for invoicing
- SOC 2 (or alternative compliance evidence) OR access to an evidence binder link
- Example invoice for mapping (PDF)

Timeline we propose:
- Day 0 (today): kickoff + onboarding packet (attached)
- Day 7: supplier intake + tax forms in to FinOps
- Day 14: PO issuance (target)
- Day 28: go-live on marketplace (soft launch)

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf (overview + required fields).

Ask: please confirm the primary billing entity name and the best finance contact (name + email) so we can route the PO. If there are any procurement constraints (special tax handling, sub-entity billing, long payment terms), flag them now so we can map to our PO template.

I'll loop in Vanessa from our finance/onboarding team for PO routing. Thanks — excited to get Orion live.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198
redwood.example

---
Attachments: redwood_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf (16 KB)
From: Jordan Lee <procurement@orion-systems.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.example>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@orion-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement sprint: vendor paperwork & PO path (Orion Systems)

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick questions from our side: 

1) Are you able to accept a UK company invoice structure (Orion has an EU entity that we'll prefer for billing)? If so, can you confirm whether Redwood needs a W-8BEN-E or local VAT registration from Orion?
2) Do you require a specific marketplace listing ID before PO issuance, or can we proceed with PO referencing the product SKU you provided on the call?
3) Who should we expect the PO from (company/legal name) and is there a specific email to send the invoice to once live?

Finance contact here is: Jordan Lee (procurement@orion-systems.com) — happy to coordinate. I'll work on the supplier intake and tax docs today.

Best,
Jordan Lee
Procurement Manager, Orion Systems
procurement@orion-systems.com

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement sprint: vendor paperwork & PO path (Orion Systems)

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the questions. Short answers first: we can accept EU billing entities and we can take W-8/W-9/VAT docs as appropriate; we just need the correct legal name and tax ID for invoicing. Marketplace listing ID is not required for the PO — the SKU and product description are sufficient for our internal PO processing.

Next steps from Redwood FinOps (ownership):
- Vanessa Ortiz will validate supplier intake fields and create a vendor record in our AP system (Workday/NetSuite).
- Ben Carter will map the example invoice to our PO fields and confirm remit-to instructions.
- Tessa will provide the formal PO template and timeline once intake is complete.

I've attached the supplier intake spreadsheet (supplier_intake_form.xlsx) and a lightweight PO template (sample-po-template.docx). Please return the intake form + tax docs to this thread. If there are bank wiring constraints (e.g., intermediary banks for SEPA), note them in the intake form so Ben can triage.

We typically target Net 30 for standard marketplace partners; if Orion needs extended terms we will escalate to finance/sales for approval.

Thanks — looping Ben for invoice mapping.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Programs Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example

Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement sprint: vendor paperwork & PO path (Orion Systems)

Great — thank you both. Quick recap and asks to close this sprint: 

Recap:
- Intake form + tax docs: Jordan to return by EOD Monday (we'll mark day 7).
- PO target: Redwood to issue by Thu, Jun 24 (Day 14) assuming intake is complete.
- Remit and invoice mapping: Ben to confirm bank fields inline after review.

Actions for Orion (please):
1) Fill and return supplier_intake_form.xlsx.
2) Attach W-8/W-9 or VAT registration PDF.
3) Provide primary billing entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO.
4) Indicate if SEPA/intermediary routing is needed.

Links for evidence and next docs: 
- Evidence binder (SOC2) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cOnboardingBinder
- Deal record in our system: https://app.redwood.example/deals/ORION-2345

If those items arrive on Monday we will keep the PO on schedule. If there are any blockers, flag them here and we'll escalate to our finance lead. Thanks again — pleased to move this forward.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
